pick.headline: Police massacre at Carandiru prison in Sao Paulo
pick.summary: On October 2, 1992, military police stormed the Carandiru prison in Sao Paulo to put down a riot, killing 111 inmates.
pick.significance: The Carandiru massacre became Brazil's emblematic case of police violence.
